label: SolaX X1/X3-Hybrid G3/G4
status_note: Public community sources only; nothing verified on hardware. Covers the X1-Hybrid and X3-Hybrid generation 3 and generation 4 inverters, identified by the serial-number prefix at holding 0x0000 (X1 G3: H1E, H1I, HCC, HUE, XRE; X3 G3: H3DE, H3E, H3LE, H3PE, H3UE; X1 G4: H43, H44, H450, H460, H475; X3 G4: H34); X1/X3-IES, X3-Ultra, X3-Hybrid G4 Pro, X1-VAST, the OEM TIGO TSI models, RetroFit/FIT/AC-coupled units, G2 and the micro/string lines are not covered. Addresses are wire (PDU) addresses; for SolaX they equal the hexadecimal register addresses of the vendor protocol (0x001C = 28), with no minus-one offset. Measurements are input registers (function 4), identification and settings read-back are holding registers (function 3). SolaX keeps separate read and write tables: a setting is written (FC6) at one address and read back at another, e.g. Charger Use Mode is written at 0x001F and read at 0x008B, so the write is declared echo-only and the mode is read from 0x008B. Control is limited to writing Charger Use Mode = 0 (Self Use, the vendor default and the same value on G3 and G4): forced charge/discharge needs Manual Mode (0x001F = 3 on G4) together with 0x0020, the non-persistent remote-control commands are multi-register FC16 writes with a lifetime, and the SoC and export settings live at generation-specific addresses with read-back elsewhere, none of which the engine can express (see docs/profiles/engine-gaps.md); grid charge, forced discharge, sell and standby therefore map to the neutral mode without power and their capabilities are false. Settings are stored in EEPROM (community docs: about 100000 write cycles), hence nvm. Live-test checklist: (1) serial prefix at 0x0000-0x0006 and rated output power at 0x00BA (W; documented for G4 only, on G3 the register is unconfirmed and may hold something else); (2) 32-bit values low word first and the scales: battery voltage 0x0014 x0.1 V, battery current 0x0015 x0.1 A (sign assumed positive while charging, like the power), energy totals 0x0048/0x004A x0.01 kWh, 0x0094 x0.1 kWh; (3) signs: battery power 0x0016 > 0 while charging and feed-in power 0x0046 > 0 while exporting (both negated here); load = inverter power 0x0002 + grid import, as the community integration computes it (without a second meter); a third PV string (0x0124 on some models) is not summed; (4) unit id 1 on port 502 through the Pocket WiFi/LAN 3.0 dongle (dongle firmware V3.004.03 or later) or RS485 through a Modbus gateway; (5) settings writes may need the 'unlock' value 2014 written to 0x0000 first, again after a power cycle (lock state readable at input 0x0054); (6) the safe write is re-writing 0 to 0x001F while 0x008B reads 0 (Self Use), then confirming 0x008B still reads 0; restore by writing back the value read from 0x008B before the test; the engine cannot do that read-back itself (echo only); (7) G3 and G4 number the other Charger Use Mode values differently (G3: 1 Force Time Use, 3 Feedin Priority; G4: 1 Feedin Priority, 3 Manual), so any value other than 0 is shown as unknown. Battery temperature limits are the generic defaults of the other profiles, not SolaX data. Not used for control until verified.

sources.what: register map: serial number at holding 0x0000 (7 registers, ASCII) and the serial-prefix table of models and generations; input registers 0x0002 inverter power (S16), 0x000A/0x000B PV1/PV2 power, 0x0014 battery voltage (0.1 V), 0x0015 battery current (0.1 A), 0x0016 battery power (S16), 0x0018 battery temperature (S16), 0x001C battery SoC, 0x0046 measured grid power (S32), 0x0048/0x004A grid export/import totals (U32, 0.01 kWh), 0x0094 total solar energy (U32, 0.1 kWh), 0x0054 lock state; 32-bit values low word first; holding read-back 0x008B charger use mode, 0x008C manual mode (G4), 0x0093 self-use minimum SoC (G4), 0x00B6 export limit, 0x00BA rated output power (G4); write registers 0x0000 lock (2014 unlock), 0x001F charger use mode (G3: 0 Self Use, 1 Force Time Use, 2 Back Up, 3 Feedin Priority; G4: 0 Self Use, 1 Feedin Priority, 2 Back Up, 3 Manual, 4 PeakShaving, 5 Smart Schedule), 0x0020 manual mode (G4: 0 stop, 1 force charge, 2 force discharge) or battery minimum capacity (G3), 0x0042 export limit, 0x0061 self-use minimum SoC (G4), 0x00E0 charge upper SoC (G4); remote-control FC16 blocks 0x007C-0x008A (modes 1-7) and 0x00A0-0x00A7 (modes 8/9); read blocks of up to 100 registers; house load = inverter power - measured power
Home Assistant sensor unique ids '<hub name>_<key>'
Home Assistant select unique ids '<hub name>_<key>' and the select write path
connection defaults: hub name SolaX, port 502, unit id 1; FC6 single-register writes by default
G4 operating modes (Self Use, Feedin Priority, Back Up, Manual with stop/force charge/force discharge) and the EEPROM write-cycle warning (about 100000 cycles)
remote-control power control (mode 1): not stored in EEPROM, limited lifetime that must be repeated, G4 and later
remote-control power control (mode 8): PV and battery limits, duration and timeout behaviour
lock state must be set to unlocked before settings can be changed, again after a power cycle; Pocket WiFi 3.0 firmware V3.004.03 or later

wire addresses equal the vendor hex addresses (0x001C read at 28), battery power 0x0016 negated (positive = charging), feed-in power 0x0046 int32 word-swapped and negated (positive = exporting), single-register writes of 0x0020 then 0x001F for hold/charge, battery wake-up 0x0056

modbus.status_note: Community integration sources only. Identification (serial 0x0000-0x0006, rated output power 0x00BA) and settings read-back (Charger Use Mode 0x008B) are holding registers (function 3); measurements are input registers (function 4). Writes are single-register FC6, as the reference integrations do. SolaX writes and reads settings at different addresses: the only write is Charger Use Mode at 0x001F, which reads back at 0x008B; 0x001F in the function-3 read table is not the mode (the community map documents no read register there; it may return an unrelated word or an exception), so `mode` is echo-only and the verify block at 0x001F exists only because the schema requires a block over every write address, not as a read-back. Re-writing 0 (Self Use) while 0x008B reads 0 is the safe probe; check 0x008B by hand afterwards. Writes may be refused until 2014 is written to 0x0000 (lock state), which the profile does not do. Through the Pocket WiFi/LAN 3.0 dongle a 5 s timeout and gap_ms 100 are conservative stand-ins, not vendor data. modbus_rtu is RS485 through a TCP gateway (port 8899 is a guess at a common gateway default; use the gateway's own port). Entity mode: the solax_modbus integration names unique ids '<hub name>_<key>' (default hub name SolaX); a hub name containing '_' does not match these regexes and needs the manual entity pick. Its Charger Use Mode select carries generation-specific options; only 'Self Use Mode' (the same on G3 and G4) is used. The SoC and export-limit numbers are mapped for display only (capabilities false). The sign of battery current is assumed, not documented.
